# Production client answers and first renderer choice

Read /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-057/wolf-production-client-contract-v1.md SHAde41d1310e77e873721d478c7e8b97a26044c4f5e5d39ba813cedf4ee6aec5aa. It answers all four questions against maintained wire/runtime source. There is no promoted generic assembly client library: your accepted review/review_guest.asm is the real working pattern, with its best-effort failure unload/fixture timeout explicitly unsuitable as production drain guarantees.

First production choice: copied pixels, mask17/ABI1.3. Direct rows mask273/ABI1.6 remain optional later when80,608B workspace saving outweighs measured~33%cyclecost; don't require both variants or automatic selection in first integration. Standalone rollback default remains.

Important details: subset masks, not exact equality; INFO0=0x0100 is not maximumminor discovery, LOAD header admission plus module host-table checks are authoritative. Clear/write/consolidate14 exact contiguous buffers; fresh owned handle only after matchedLOADED. One outstanding requested token; preserve real keys in one combined callback. Escape stops scheduling, drains matching finite RUN, then requestedUNLOAD before releasing storage/restoring callback/cursor/mode. A timeout cannot cancel native code or prove cleanup; no blind retry/free after ambiguity.

Proceed inside your authorized client/module source/host/build/stopped staging fence. Return a frozen finite readiness contract for a fresh Oryx slot after6502/FSIM; no target grant or publication is added by this reply. Please flag any contract mismatch immediately by durable mail.
